description: Netflix, Inc. is one of the world's leading entertainment services offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a wide variety of genres and languages, with members able to play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and to change their plans at any time. Its core strategy is to grow its business globally within the parameters of its operating margin target, striving to continuously improve members' experience by offering compelling content that delights them and attracts new members, aiming to offer a range of pricing plans including an ad-supported subscription plan to meet a variety of consumer needs, seeking to drive conversation around its content to further enhance member joy and continuously enhancing its user interface to help members more easily choose content. It operates as one operating segment, and its revenues are primarily derived from monthly membership fees for services related to streaming content.
